lastCompletedStory.title: Real-git integration tests: migration, CAS, allocateId race, cross-branch read

nextStoryContext: US-010 complete. Six real-git integration tests in test/integration/issue-dir-real-git.test.ts prove: AC#1 migration idempotency (migrateIssuesToDir converts multi-issue array to per-file dir in one atomic commit; re-run is no-op), AC#2 CAS concurrent-commit guard (intercepted update-ref failure triggers re-read+retry, no commit lost), AC#3 allocateId race -- two back-to-back allocations yield distinct sequential ids (2 tests: sequential calls + CAS-retry re-allocation), AC#4 cross-branch read (just-filed issue visible from feature branch via readBacklogFromMain). BUG FIXED: removePathsFromIndex used --remove which silently no-ops when the file exists in the working tree; changed to --force-remove. Unit test assertions in migrate-to-dir.test.ts updated accordingly. All 10 user stories in this PRD now pass. Gate spine: typecheck clean, 2056 tests pass (2050 baseline + 6 new).

officialDocsValidated.summary: git-scm docs confirm: --remove only removes a file from the index when it is ABSENT from the working tree; --force-remove removes unconditionally. The removePathsFromIndex function in src/git/on-main.ts was using --remove (wrong) and has been corrected to --force-remove.
